summary: The introduction page fully adheres to its outline, assigned word count, and scope boundaries. It sets clear context for Canadian quality and operations teams evaluating CAPA software, reviews all nine guide chapters in logical sequence, and establishes essential principles such as role accountability and separation of duties. Citations to ISO/IAF Auditing Practices Group guidance papers and NIST quality guides are accurately cited with appropriate disclaimers. Hypothetical examples are explicitly designated, and no unassigned FAQ section is present.

glossary.definition: Action to eliminate a detected nonconformity (ISO 9000 as quoted in the ISO/IAF APG paper).
Action to eliminate the cause of a nonconformity and prevent recurrence.
Immediate steps that limit the effect of a finding while its cause is investigated.
Follow-up evidence check that a corrective action prevented recurrence before closure.
The role responsible for decisions and records in the defined workflow.
Non-fulfillment of a requirement (ISO 9000 as cited in the APG paper).
